# Overview {.unnumbered}

These labs give practical experience with machine learning (ML) systems. Unlike large models that require data center-scale resources, these exercises let you work directly with hardware and software using TinyML. This gives a tangible understanding of the challenges of deploying AI, albeit at a tiny scale. The principles are largely the same as those you would meet in larger systems.

![Nicla Vision. Source: Arduino.](./images/jpg/nicla_vision_quarter.jpeg){width=70%}

## Where to Buy {#sec-overview-where-to-buy}

The Arduino Nicla Vision is available from the official Arduino Store:

- [Arduino Store](https://store.arduino.cc/products/nicla-vision) (~$95)

## Pre-requisites {#sec-overview-prerequisites-b2d4}

- **Nicla Vision Board**: Ensure you have the Nicla Vision board.
- **USB Cable**: For connecting the board to your computer.
- **Network**: With internet access for downloading necessary software.

## Setup {#sec-overview-setup-cde0}

- [Setup Nicla Vision](setup/setup.qmd)
